reviewFocus: Colors, fonts and icons go through DesignSystem.swift and WktSymbol / .wktIcon(); no hardcoded systemName strings or hand-copied colour literals.
Activity-appropriate language: a run says run, a ride says ride. Any hardcoded 'Walk' on a surface that can show another activity is a bug (ActivityMode).
Session lifecycle: anything touching an active session survives backgrounding, force-quit, and the Live Activity / mini-tile end paths. HealthKit workouts and Live Activities end on every exit path.
Notifications go through NotificationService, and any delivery guard accepts .provisional.
UI-test accessibility identifiers listed in CLAUDE.md keep working; tab bar buttons are addressed by title.
No NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription unless code calls requestAlwaysAuthorization (Always was rejected 2026-09-09).
